thread:
julia_fin: Putting a short rollback & emergency stop plan on the table for the upcoming A/B price experiment (high-throughput SKU). Need ops + billing + legal eyes before publish. Draft commit: https://drive.company/fin/experiments/rollback-plan-2026.md :eyes:

sam_ops: Good call. Main ops triggers we propose: 1) billing anomaly >0.75% of daily tokens billed vs expected; 2) spike in failed invoices >0.5% in 1h; 3) sustained 15% increase in 95p latency for token generation across affected pool. Any of these -> immediate experiment halt & auto-route heavy traffic to Dedicated pool.

hugo_product: For analytics we want two dashboards: "experiment health" (MRR delta, invoice failure rate, latency) and "rollback candidates" (top 25 affected accounts by delta). Hugo: will you own dashboards?

hugo_product: I'll own dashboards. Need the exact metric definitions from billing/ops by EOD.

mei_eng: Implementation notes: we can flip a global feature-flag to pause the experiment within 90s; safe rollback job to revert per-customer rate_override will run and issue prorated credits for current period only. Accounts without invoice snapshots will be listed in a manual-review CSV. Cutover timestamp must be precise (we use ISO UTC). Suggested cutover: 2026-04-12T16:00:00Z.

julia_fin: Credit policy on rollback: prorated credit for remainder of billing period; no retro credits for closed invoices. Any disputed closed invoices go to RevOps for manual adjustments. Finance to own reconciliation.

tara_sales: Sales request: if we halt the experiment, notify affected customers within 24h and give reps a template. Also need a Console badge: "experiment-paused" visible to reps.

billingbot: Snapshot coverage check: invoice_snapshots = 95.0%. Missing IDs: acct_221, acct_778. Recommend archival check: archive_tool --ids acct_221,acct_778

mei_eng: Backfill behavior: when rollback job runs it will skip accounts missing snapshots and create tickets in Zendesk for manual handling. We'll emit an audit event for each automated credit. ETA for feature-flag + rollback job = 4 business days.

ana_legal: Legal: ensure messaging to customers includes clear language about automatic rollback and credits. I'll draft a short clause for the publish note and the email template. Retain opt-in/opt-out records per retention policy.

julia_fin: Approval matrix: finance approves credit policy; legal signoff on messaging; product + eng on rollback procedure; ops + infra on routing. Target signoffs by Wed to keep publish on Mon.

sam_ops: Also adding a canary: start experiment with 1000 low-volume accounts for 48h, then ramp if health metrics ok. I'll post canary list link in #eng-infra.

hugo_product: Agree with canary. We'll measure net MRR lift and gross margin delta at 24/48/72h checkpoints.

tara_sales: Preparing rep FAQ + email templates. Will sync with Legal on language.

billingbot: Reminder: staging billing simulation scheduled 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z. Use cohort file: https://drive.company/fin/cohorts/rollback-sim-1k.csv

julia_fin: Thanks everyone. If no blockers I'll lock the price sheet and publish the plan for review tomorrow. Post any final issues here.
